## Architecture map

- **Application and workflow:** Python 3.11–3.13 package with a Typer CLI and FastAPI/HTMX/SSE viewer. A single-process `Supervisor` parses a goal, creates initial literature-generation tasks, claims a bounded number of SQLite tasks, schedules follow-ups, and stops on budget, wall clock, Elo stability, or idle. Defaults set task concurrency to four. [README architecture](https://github.com/Kaimen-Inc/Co-Scientist/blob/cef5bcfec8820865855593b437a941005a9f961a/README.md#L39-L82) · [Supervisor bootstrap and loop](https://github.com/Kaimen-Inc/Co-Scientist/blob/cef5bcfec8820865855593b437a941005a9f961a/co_scientist/agents/supervisor.py#L74-L153) · [claim and follow-up scheduling](https://github.com/Kaimen-Inc/Co-Scientist/blob/cef5bcfec8820865855593b437a941005a9f961a/co_scientist/agents/supervisor.py#L282-L390).
- **Agents:** Generation creates one hypothesis per task from literature search; Reflection writes a full review; Ranking chooses pairwise or debate comparisons and updates Elo; Evolution transforms selected hypotheses; Proximity embeds, deduplicates, and clusters; Meta-review writes system feedback and a final overview. The README's broader advertised modes are narrowed in executable code (see below). [Agent modules](https://github.com/Kaimen-Inc/Co-Scientist/tree/cef5bcfec8820865855593b437a941005a9f961a/co_scientist/agents).
- **Prompts and structured records:** Fourteen Jinja Markdown templates are registered in `co_scientist/llm/prompts.py`. `agents/schemas.py` defines JSON Schema tool inputs for hypotheses, reviews, system feedback, safety, rubric scores, and research plans. API providers receive tool schemas directly; CLI backends use the bundled MCP server to expose `record_*` tools and validate/capture records. [Template registry](https://github.com/Kaimen-Inc/Co-Scientist/blob/cef5bcfec8820865855593b437a941005a9f961a/co_scientist/llm/prompts.py#L21-L67) · [record schemas](https://github.com/Kaimen-Inc/Co-Scientist/blob/cef5bcfec8820865855593b437a941005a9f961a/co_scientist/agents/schemas.py#L14-L129) · [MCP record boundary](https://github.com/Kaimen-Inc/Co-Scientist/blob/cef5bcfec8820865855593b437a941005a9f961a/co_scientist/mcp/server.py#L17-L30).
- **Citation and evidence handling:** Generation filters citations to URLs seen in its search/fetch tool results; Reflection similarly drops evidence records whose URLs were not seen. A separate `CitationVerifier` fetches a page and tests whether the first 200 characters of an excerpt occur after whitespace/case normalization. That verifier has no call site in the pinned Python tree, and its method returns statuses rather than performing the artifact mutation/event emission described by its docstring. [Generation URL filter call](https://github.com/Kaimen-Inc/Co-Scientist/blob/cef5bcfec8820865855593b437a941005a9f961a/co_scientist/agents/generation.py#L129-L138) · [verifier implementation](https://github.com/Kaimen-Inc/Co-Scientist/blob/cef5bcfec8820865855593b437a941005a9f961a/co_scientist/safety/citation_verifier.py#L1-L80).
- **Proximity and vectors:** Per-session FAISS `IndexFlatIP` stores normalized vectors for exact cosine search. Configured Voyage/OpenAI embeddings fall back to a deterministic hashed-token/bigram embedder when keys are absent; that fallback explicitly captures token overlap rather than paraphrase. Batch reclustering uses sklearn average-linkage agglomerative clustering. [Proximity agent](https://github.com/Kaimen-Inc/Co-Scientist/blob/cef5bcfec8820865855593b437a941005a9f961a/co_scientist/agents/proximity.py#L26-L127) · [embedding fallback](https://github.com/Kaimen-Inc/Co-Scientist/blob/cef5bcfec8820865855593b437a941005a9f961a/co_scientist/vectors/embedder.py#L127-L206) · [FAISS store](https://github.com/Kaimen-Inc/Co-Scientist/blob/cef5bcfec8820865855593b437a941005a9f961a/co_scientist/vectors/store.py#L1-L90).
- **Storage and task recovery:** SQLite uses WAL, `synchronous=NORMAL`, foreign keys, and a 5-second busy timeout. The base schema holds sessions, hypotheses, reviews, tournament/Elo records, leased tasks, transcripts, feedback, embedding metadata, spans, events, and migration tracking; migrations add three bench tables and bench fields. The DB module documents one connection per process. Task rows use unique idempotency keys, atomic `UPDATE … RETURNING` claims, leases, retries, and dead-letter status; the repository currently ignores the supplied retry-backoff list. [DB connection and migrations](https://github.com/Kaimen-Inc/Co-Scientist/blob/cef5bcfec8820865855593b437a941005a9f961a/co_scientist/storage/db.py#L1-L99) · [base schema](https://github.com/Kaimen-Inc/Co-Scientist/blob/cef5bcfec8820865855593b437a941005a9f961a/co_scientist/storage/schema.sql#L7-L191) · [queue semantics](https://github.com/Kaimen-Inc/Co-Scientist/blob/cef5bcfec8820865855593b437a941005a9f961a/co_scientist/storage/repos/tasks.py#L25-L189).
- **Tests and evaluation:** The checkout contains 34 unit-test modules, including fake-provider/tool-loop, prompt-rendering, schema validation, task repositories, routing, budget, and vector tests. It also has rubric evaluations with structural offline checks plus optional model judging. Only generation and ranking JSONL fixture files are shipped; reflection and overview are registered rubrics but have no corresponding fixtures in this tree. [Test tree](https://github.com/Kaimen-Inc/Co-Scientist/tree/cef5bcfec8820865855593b437a941005a9f961a/co_scientist/tests/unit) · [eval runner and fixture behavior](https://github.com/Kaimen-Inc/Co-Scientist/blob/cef5bcfec8820865855593b437a941005a9f961a/co_scientist/evals/runner.py#L1-L16).
- **Benchmarks:** A checked-in report records 20 historical cross-model benches, seven with gold-set scoring, and candidly says the direct-versus-pipeline Elo result was not reproducible at the sample size. Those API-preset runs used metered OpenRouter calls. The report is generated from local `data/co_scientist.db` plus artifacts; neither the DB nor artifacts are in the pinned tree, so the committed report is inspectable but the underlying runs are not self-contained here. [Report scope and caveats](https://github.com/Kaimen-Inc/Co-Scientist/blob/cef5bcfec8820865855593b437a941005a9f961a/docs/BENCH_RESULTS.md#L1-L58) · [bench presets/method](https://github.com/Kaimen-Inc/Co-Scientist/blob/cef5bcfec8820865855593b437a941005a9f961a/co_scientist/bench/presets.py#L1-L49).
- **Operational assumptions:** OpenRouter is the default and default model IDs include metered Claude models; the sample run budget is 5M tokens / $25. The cost table labels itself approximate and says users must verify it; unknown prices are inferred from model-name families or a Sonnet-class fallback. CLI backends avoid per-token API billing but still require local signed-in CLIs, and vector/search features may use separate Voyage/OpenAI/Tavily/Brave credentials. No zero-cost admission boundary is present in this project. [Provider defaults](https://github.com/Kaimen-Inc/Co-Scientist/blob/cef5bcfec8820865855593b437a941005a9f961a/co_scientist/config.py#L20-L59) · [cost-table caveat and route policy](https://github.com/Kaimen-Inc/Co-Scientist/blob/cef5bcfec8820865855593b437a941005a9f961a/co_scientist/llm/routing.py#L1-L16) · [budget admission](https://github.com/Kaimen-Inc/Co-Scientist/blob/cef5bcfec8820865855593b437a941005a9f961a/co_scientist/llm/budgets.py#L63-L92).

## Shipped code versus README claims

- The README says its supplementary pseudocode, prompts, and diagrams are in `reference/`, but that directory is absent from the pinned Git tree. Fourteen prompt templates are present; their claimed verbatim relationship to the absent files cannot be verified from this checkout. [README source claim](https://github.com/Kaimen-Inc/Co-Scientist/blob/cef5bcfec8820865855593b437a941005a9f961a/README.md#L7-L11).
- The README advertises Generation debate and Reflection deep verification. `GenerationAgent` rejects every strategy except `literature`; `ReflectionAgent` rejects every review kind except `full`. Corresponding prompt/schema values exist, but they are not active execution paths at this revision. [Generation guard](https://github.com/Kaimen-Inc/Co-Scientist/blob/cef5bcfec8820865855593b437a941005a9f961a/co_scientist/agents/generation.py#L36-L50) · [Reflection guard](https://github.com/Kaimen-Inc/Co-Scientist/blob/cef5bcfec8820865855593b437a941005a9f961a/co_scientist/agents/reflection.py#L27-L45).
- The citation verifier is implemented as an isolated helper, but a repository-wide reference search found no invocation; do not count it as active citation verification.
- The checked-in bench report references machine-local DB/artifact paths absent from this source tree. It is historical evidence, not a clean-room reproducibility bundle.

## Open comparison questions for M2-02

1. **Citation provenance:** Compare seen-URL filtering and the dormant excerpt substring verifier with local claim/evidence edges, verification-method lineage, freshness, and publication gates (`app/app/claim_verifier.py`, `app/app/claim_grounding.py`, `app/app/claims_gate.py`). Is there a small provenance mechanism worth adapting, or does the local claim-level contract already cover it more rigorously?
2. **Structured output:** Compare provider-native tool schemas plus the CLI MCP `record_*` capture path and its fallback validator with the local `call_llm_json` request/schema/retry seam (`engine/src/co_scientist/llm_json.py`, `engine/src/co_scientist/llm_request_schema.py`). Which interoperability behavior is missing locally, if any?
3. **Proximity:** Compare exact-cosine FAISS dedup/clustering, embedding fallback, and its use in tournament pairing with `engine/src/co_scientist/agents/proximity/` and current ranking code. Does any behavior improve measured duplicate recall without increasing false merges or weakening whole-pool safeguards?
4. **Scheduling:** Compare Kaimen's one-process SQLite queue, lease/idempotency rules, and idle follow-up scheduler with the local durable task worker, recovery, and single-writer constraints (`app/app/store/tasks.py`, `app/app/task_worker.py`, `engine/src/co_scientist/agents/supervisor/`). Which semantics are complementary, and which are already covered?
5. **Routing and budgets:** Compare per-agent routes, degradation chains, per-agent reservation shares, and estimated USD accounting against the local zero-cost admission and provider budget boundary (`engine/src/co_scientist/llm_gateway_routing.py`, `engine/src/co_scientist/llm_call_budget.py`). Can any scheduling/telemetry idea transfer without importing stale prices, automatic fallback, or weakening zero-cost controls?
6. **Evaluation:** Compare Kaimen's gold-set entity recall and direct-versus-pipeline Elo protocol, including its low-sample caveat and missing underlying run artifacts, with the local frozen paired-evaluation identity and scientific-quality gates. Is there a useful metric or fixture design to add, with fixed reproducible inputs?

No candidate disposition is made in M2-01; these are questions for the comparison item.
